xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4475: Shared Sessions v0 (slice 4): viewer surface, join intent and localhost-detect

plan.title: Shared Sessions v0 (slice 4): viewer surface, join intent and localhost-detect
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: About 28 files across about 13 path-subsystems because the lint counts each top-level doc file (docs.json, anywhere.mdx, configuration/…, each docs/*.md) and each test root (tests/unit, tests/integration, scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt) separately. The code is one vertical feature: the viewer server, its routes, the browser peer and the page are useless without each other, and the issue names the landing page and the user docs page as part of this slice (PRD D-21).

narratives.Problem: Slices 1-3 let a host create a share, admit viewers and stream the conversation over WebRTC, but no viewer-side code exists: nothing opens the join socket, no browser answers the host's offer, no page renders shared content, and the landing page tells joiners to run a pan join command that does not exist yet.
narratives.Proposal: Add a viewer-server JoinManager (join socket with the device token, state table, keepalive, leave, signal relay, ICE servers, one-subscriber rule with socket restart, grace timer) behind /api/joins routes and an SSE event stream; a browser WebRtcViewer answerer that negotiates the hello and decodes conversation and presence; a /#/shared/<code> route with a Join confirmation and lobby/admitted/host-disconnected/removed screens reusing MessagesTimeline; a nonce'd localhost-detect script on the share service landing page backed by a CORS-restricted /api/share-probe; unit, route, frontend, Miniflare integration and two-context Playwright tests; and user plus developer docs. Full design: .pan/drafts/PAN-4475.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- pan join / pan share CLI (slice 9), hosted web join (slice 10), forced-TURN and signaling-privacy e2e (slice 11)
- Drafts, contributor direct-submit or any prompt sending from the viewer (slice 5); read-only terminal (slice 6); controller handoff (slice 7)
- Automatic join-socket reconnect after a network drop, host re-park, host-side restore (slice 8)
- A full roster UI, per-message avatars, or rendering SharedMessage.author
- Rendering tool calls, work log, thinking, cost or context usage for viewers
- A pan:// protocol handler or desktop-app join path
- Probing ports other than 3011 from the landing page or a Worker variable for the port list
- Changing routes/shares.ts, share-host.ts, peer-hub.ts, the room reducer, ws-rpc.ts or main.ts
- Adding /api/share-probe to REMOTE_GATE_ALLOWLIST or sending CORS headers for any origin other than the configured share origin
- A join started by navigation alone (GET or page load) without the user's Join click, except auto-resume of an 'away' join
- New src/lib/errors.ts tags, allowlist raises, adding the Playwright spec to test:playwright, or deploying anything

autoDecisions.summary: Join intent is an explicit Join click on the local /#/shared/<code> page, sent as a same-origin CSRF POST; the landing page only navigates and probes (D-1).
autoDecisions.rationale: Opening the join socket reveals the joiner's GitHub identity to the host; a drive-by navigation must not do that, and a cross-origin POST would have to bypass CSRF.

autoDecisions.summary: Browser ⇄ viewer server uses server-sent events plus POSTs (D-2).
autoDecisions.rationale: Low-latency push for trickled ICE with an existing SSE precedent (machines-peer.ts); avoids new /ws upgrade plumbing or five-file /ws/rpc event changes.

autoDecisions.summary: One subscriber per join, last one wins; a re-subscribe on an admitted join restarts the socket with a plain close to get a fresh offer (D-4, D-5).
autoDecisions.rationale: The host holds one peer per GitHub id and offers only on a connected false→true flip (slice-3 D-13); a leave frame would re-lobby the viewer.

autoDecisions.summary: A 60 s unsubscribed grace timer closes the join to 'away'; the page auto-resumes an away join (D-7).
autoDecisions.rationale: Closed tabs must not leave a viewer listed in the room forever, while reloads must not drop admission.

autoDecisions.summary: No automatic join-socket reconnect after an unexpected close; Rejoin button instead (D-8).
autoDecisions.rationale: Automatic restore is slice 8 (PAN-4479); the service already restores an admitted viewer on rejoin.

autoDecisions.summary: Landing page probes only localhost:3011 and 127.0.0.1:3011 with a nonce'd inline script and always shows a manual link (D-14).
autoDecisions.rationale: 3011 is the default dashboard port; a manual link covers other ports and a denied Chrome Local Network Access prompt.

autoDecisions.summary: The landing page drops the 'pan join' line until slice 9 (D-15).
autoDecisions.rationale: pan join does not exist yet; telling users to run it would be wrong.

autoDecisions.summary: /api/share-probe sends CORS headers only for the configured share origin, answers the PNA preflight, and stays off REMOTE_GATE_ALLOWLIST (D-16).
autoDecisions.rationale: Lets the landing page detect Overdeck without exposing it to other sites or LAN peers.

autoDecisions.summary: MessagesTimeline is reused bare with workLog [] and a field-by-field SharedMessage→ChatMessage copy (D-13).
autoDecisions.rationale: TerminalPanel.tsx already renders it that way; tool calls and work log are not shared in v0.

autoDecisions.summary: The Playwright spec is not added to test:playwright; the Miniflare integration test is the CI-run relay coverage (D-20).
autoDecisions.rationale: Follows slice-2 D-16; the spec needs two built dashboards and Chromium.
The short code is the only room identifier that exists.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4 and decisions D-4, D-5, D-6, D-7, D-9. Add subscribe (last subscriber wins; previous gets {type:'replaced'}; emits current state at once; restart when state is admitted/host-disconnected and the generation already had a subscriber, else flush pendingSignals), signal (only when admitted and OPEN), iceServers (prefetch on status admitted, 50 min cache, 5 s timeout or turn_unavailable → []), the 60 s unsubscribed grace timer (plain close 1000 → away), and restart (close 1000 'reconnect' with NO leave frame, reopen only from the close event, terminate fallback after 5 s). Implementation checkpoint D-5: if WI-10 shows no second offer after restart, add JOIN_RESTART_REOPEN_DELAY_MS = 500 and comment why.
